During dance battles, a Judgment Gauge is displayed
in the center of the screen.

When the clock hand makes one full rotation, the final judgment
will be made. The dancer with fewer accurate button presses
by then will take damage and lose health.

The amount of damage that will be dealt to the loser is shown by the color
of the bomb icon on the Judgment Gauge.
During the battle, the bomb icon continually moves toward the dancer
with fewer accurate button presses.

If a dancer's health reaches zero,
he or she becomes unable to dance
and loses the battle at that point, regardless of the score.

When the Heat Gauge reaches a certain point, the Dance Heat icon
will appear at the top left of the screen.
Press <Color:1><Action:Button_L1@Street_Battle><Color:10> during this time to use a Dance Heat move.

Pressing <Color:1><Action:Button_L1@Street_Battle><Color:10> will display the Dance Heat selection screen.
Here, you can choose the Dance Heat move you wish to use.

However, if you don't make a selection within the limited time provided, 
you will lose that opportunity to use a Dance Heat move.

The icon next to the Health Gauge represents the dancer's spirits.
The higher the spirit, the more efficiently the dancer will earn points.
Spirit is affected by the number of accurate button presses.

Haruka's idol abilities rise as she takes lessons and performs jobs.

There are four idol abilities.

<Color:35>Singing: Improved mainly through lessons.
<Color:36>Appeal: Improved mainly via jobs such as handshake events.
<Color:37>Performance: Improved mainly via dance events and dance battles.
<Color:38>Basic Skill: Improved by raising Haruka's level.

In concert battles, each ability corresponds to a button. The higher these abilities,
the more points you will get for accurate button presses.

<Color:39>Raising the idol abilities as high as you can is the key to success in concert battles,
so be sure to improve Haruka's abilities through activities such as jobs and lessons.

Now that Haruka has received a quick-change outfit from Yoko,
she can use Climax Heat on the Princess League.

When an icon like the one at the right appears during a concert battle.
press the button indicated, and Haruka will change costumes.
Idol Heat will then remain until the end of the song,
making button presses more effective.

In order to use Climax Heat on the Princess League,
your Climax Heat Gauge must be filled beforehand.
Go see Yoko before the final round to fill your gauge.

The Legendary Arena Grand Prix pits the top ranked fighter against
the next three highest ranked contenders itching to be number one.
Who will be left standing after this clash of the titans!?

The Ranked Arena Grand Prix is open to only the highest ranked
fighters chosen to wage battle in the Underground Coliseum. This
is truly a battle to crown the ultimate fighter!

The Maximum Grand Prix features the greatest battles waged between
the ultimate fighters. Bear witness to epic combat between heroic
warriors who have overcome countless ordeals to make it here!

The team attacks come fast and furious in the Twin Dragon Grand
Prix, where the Underground Coliseum's number one tag team will
be decided!

The Weapon Master Grand Prix was established to satisfy those fans
who felt craved more from unarmed combat. Get ready for the thrills
and chills that can only come in an epic clash of weaponry!

Anything goes in the Street Fight Grand Prix. Lethal weapons and
blatant infractions are legal, and even encouraged to faithfully recreate
the fights waged on the streets of Kamurocho!

Limited health and many opponents! That's what Limited Berserk
is all about. How long can you keep fighting under such extreme
conditions? The only things you can count on are your wits and skill!

King of Kings is a battle royale waged between the best fighters
under the most extreme conditions. This is the violent bloodletting
the Underground Coliseum has been waiting for!

Get ready for Deathmatch 100, a seemingly endless journey of
violence and opponents beyond measure! But the journey does end
if you survive, and awaiting you is a fortune in prize money!

A black abyss lies just beyond the confines of the shattered battle
cage. Fall in, and you automatically lose. In the Breakout Grand Prix,
knocking out your opponents takes on a whole new meaning!

Bombs rain down and scorching hot plates increase as time goes by.
Welcome to the Heat Bomber Grand Prix. You've never seen a coliseum
battle like this!
